spans.s:
√śuc (śócati, -te; śuśóca; áśocīt; śociṣyáti;
śócitum; śocitvā́).
 —1. flame,
light, beam; glow, burn;
 —2. fig. suffer
burning pain; grieve; grieve at (loc.),
66^13; --intens. flame brightly. [for mg 2,
cf. √tap, dagdha and √dah.]
+ apa, intens. [1002a], drive away by
flaming brightly, 72^8.
+ abhi, burn, trans.
+ ā, bring hither by flaming, 72^8.

śúci, a.
 —1. flaming, beaming; fig. beaming
(of a smile); light, bright;
 —2. fig.
clear, pure; holy (of a god), 80^5; honorable
(in business), 25^2; pure (in a ritual
sense), 62^10. [√śuc, 1155. 2a, 216. 2.]

sūcī́ and sūcí, f.
 —1. needle;
 —2. generalized,
a pointed object; and so
 —3. (like
Eng. pointer) indicator; index. [prob. fr.
√sīv, sīū, q. v.]

śuci-smita, a. having a beaming smile,
bright-smiling.

su-cira, a. very long; -am, adv. very
long.
